title: Gan doesn't consider himself a vacuum cleaner

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: Hello. Thank you for respecting my privacy, and keeping my fate secret from my wife.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello. Thank you for respecting my privacy, and keeping my fate secret from my wife.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No problem, but I want to ask you something!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No problem, but I want to ask you something!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No problem, but I want to ask you something!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No problem, but I want to ask you something!

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: What do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's not what I came for.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's not what I came for.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's not what I came for.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's not what I came for.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need a cleaner bot in my restaurant.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need a cleaner bot in my restaurant.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I need a cleaner bot in my restaurant.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I need a cleaner bot in my restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You've got some special qualities I need!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You've got some special qualities I need!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You've got some special qualities I need!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You've got some special qualities I need!

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: Yes?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'd pay 4 Lims per hour.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd pay 4 Lims per hour.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Interested?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Interested?

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: Ah, you think just because I look like a vacuum cleaner ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, you think just because I look like a vacuum cleaner ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, you are a vacuum cleaner!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, you are a vacuum cleaner!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, you are a vacuum cleaner!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, you are a vacuum cleaner!

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: ... because I look like a vacuum cleaner, that makes me a vacuum cleaner?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... because I look like a vacuum cleaner, that makes me a vacuum cleaner?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Honestly? Yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Honestly? Yes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Now that you put it like that ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now that you put it like that ...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Now that you put it like that ...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Now that you put it like that ...

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: I am much more! I am a being! I was a highly qualified engineer in my lifetime.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am much more! I am a being! I was a highly qualified engineer in my lifetime.

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: I could construct a vacuum cleaner from the items in your trash over a lunch-break!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I could construct a vacuum cleaner from the items in your trash over a lunch-break!

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: And it would have a better dust filter than this one, too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And it would have a better dust filter than this one, too.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How about 5 Lims an hour?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How about 5 Lims an hour?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So, will you take the job?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, will you take the job?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So, will you take the job?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So, will you take the job?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I assume that's a "no?"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I assume that's a "no?"

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: You can raise it to 1000 Lims per hour. The answer remains the same!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can raise it to 1000 Lims per hour. The answer remains the same!

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: You're not great at reading people, are you? The answer is no.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not great at reading people, are you? The answer is no.

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: A hard "no"!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A hard "no"!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, if you ever run into hard times, you know where to find me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, if you ever run into hard times, you know where to find me!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, if you ever run into hard times, you know where to find me!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, if you ever run into hard times, you know where to find me!

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: You mean cleaning?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean cleaning?
